summary: First testing pass for LOPI MVP. Ran 19 pytest cases (all pass) covering health, categories, cities, register/login/me, interests, profile PATCH, parches feed with filters, create/join/leave/like/save, capacity=full, invalid category, user detail, seed volume. Ran Playwright mobile-viewport UI smoke covering login (wrong+correct), home feed rendering with 20 cards, parche detail Unirme→Salir toggle, Explore search+filter chips (when/city/category), Create parche→routes to detail→appears in Home, MyParches tabs, Profile hero+edit modal save+logout, and Register→Interests(5)→Home flow. Applied one backend fix to seeding.

issues: React Native web deprecation warnings in console: 'textShadow*'/'shadow*' style props deprecated (use 'textShadow'/'boxShadow'), and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only, non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Silence React Native web deprecation warnings by migrating textShadow*/shadow* props on LoginTagline and ParcheCard shadow (theme.shadow.card) to new 'textShadow'/'boxShadow' style shorthand. Cosmetic.

(Optional) Registration flow currently uploads photo AFTER register; if Emergent Object Storage is unavailable, this fails silently — user still lands on interests. That behavior is fine, but consider surfacing a small toast when photo upload fails.
critical_code_review_comments: Seeder was NOT idempotent: original guard `if users.count > 0: return` combined with an earlier crash (`random.sample(...) k=random.randint(5,25)` > population of 15) left the DB in a broken state — 15 users seeded but 0 parches, and every subsequent restart skipped seeding. Fixed the guard to seed users and parches independently (see server.py `_seed`). After fix, verified: 15 users + 20 parches.

server.py `_serialize_parche` performs one DB round-trip per parche to fetch creator — O(N) queries on /parches/feed. For 20 items this is fine, but consider batching with $in for future performance if feeds grow.
Registration: /auth/register does not require a photo, which matches spec. The photo path uses a separate /upload endpoint that depends on Emergent Object Storage — acceptable per problem statement.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed idempotent seed guard: check parches independently and re-seed after crash)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; instead fixed the seed bug so the built-in seeder actually populates 15 users + 20 parches on startup. Cleaned all TEST_* users/parches created during testing so DB ends at exactly 15 users, 20 parches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://lopi-web.preview.emergentagent.com/api is fully functional. All 19 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_lopi_backend.py pass. Seeder is now idempotent. Demo login: carolinav / Demo1234!. All frontend testIDs from the review are present and working. If the frontend is reworked, keep this pytest suite for regression.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: after fresh backend boot, GET /api/parches/feed returned []. Root cause found in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: `_seed()` crashed with ValueError('Sample larger than population or is negative') at `random.sample([u['id'] for u in users], k=random.randint(5,25))` because population size = 15 users < max k=25. The users had already been inserted via insert_many before the parches loop crashed. On next restart, `if db.users.count > 0: return` short-circuited, permanently skipping the parches seed. E1 subsequently patched the random.sample k range (now `k=random.randint(3, min(12, len(users)))`), but the DB was left in the broken state. Fix applied: rewrote `_seed()` to (1) only insert seeded usernames not already present, then (2) independently check `db.parches.count_documents({}) >= len(SEED_PARCHES)` before inserting parches. Restarted backend → seeded 20 parches. Verified via pytest and UI (20 cards on Home feed).
